key_insight: A solver-guided LLM can choose the best mixed-integer formulation for each multi-warehouse inventory instance, improving allocation quality beyond any single fixed formulation.
engineering_relevance: This enables instance-wise optimization in supply chain systems, where formulation choice adapts to changing demand, inventory, and service conditions instead of relying on one static model.
method: Built an OR expert library of solver-executable MIP formulations, each encoding a different allocation priority.
Trained the selector with balanced expert-conditioned supervised fine-tuning, then converted solver-evaluated quality gaps into IPO preferences and GRPO rewards.
Used per-instance expert-score metadata for reward lookup during policy optimization.
evidence_signal: On JD.com multi-warehouse inventory instances, GRPO raised Hit Ratio@1 from 21.45% to 50.42% and improved allocation accuracy by 12.57 percentage points, reducing the gap to the ex-post oracle to 4.85 points.
watch_item: Performance depends on high-quality solver-evaluated labels and a curated expert library, so deployment may be sensitive to solver cost, instance shift, and formulation coverage.
paper_title: Large Language Model for Operations Research Formulation Selection in Multi-Warehouse Inventory Allocation
